event: The user is asking to identify the location of the speaker relative to a robot's position (at the dark wooden front door) and orientation (facing the light-gray armchair further from the wall painting) when the speech topic "inquiring about availability of a water filter" comes up.

sounding_object.description: A woman with long, dark, curly brown hair, wearing glasses, a black short-sleeved crop top, and light blue high-waisted jeans. She has a small black rectangular device (possibly a microphone pack) clipped to her front waistband.

reference_object.description: A dark brown wooden front door with a curved top and a small, high rectangular window. It has a black handle. It is located on the right wall of the living room when entering from the initial hallway archway.

facing_object.object_name: Light-gray armchair further from the wall painting
facing_object.description: A light-gray upholstered armchair with dark wooden legs. In the living room, there are two such armchairs. A wall painting is visible on the left wall next to a fireplace. The armchair further from this painting is the one more towards the right side of the room or further towards the back of the living room (near a large arched window).

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the dark wooden front door and facing the light-gray armchair further from the wall painting, when the speech topic: "inquiring about availability of a water filter" comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the speaker: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
